purpose: Compare BP, locked SVD+BP fusion, and fresh Astra direct edits after integrating cached Llama-3 title+description vectors; distinguish numeric feature integration from raw-description access.

dataset.scope: Same historical cohort and chronological split used earlier; no claim of new untouched test corpus. No synthetic model perturbations this round.

text.input: Previously encoded fixed instruction + title + public description + suffix; reuse exact cached vectors, no new Llama fitting or extraction.
text.alignment: Verify cached1568rows exactly correspond to existing anonymous item mapping and original1682row cache.
text.preprocessing: Deterministic centered PCA64 with component sign canonicalization, no whitening, row L2 normalization. Fit all catalogue metadata only, no interactions or held-out labels; transductive metadata access is explicit.
text.shuffled_control: Fixed NumPy default_rng(2026110741) permutation of feature rows, preserving feature multiset; supplementary BP control, same architecture and training selection budget.

models.none: 16D biased MF trained by BPR BP.
models.text: score(u,i)=bias+user_bias[u]+item_bias[i]+U[u] dot (V[i]+X[i]W), U,V16D; frozen X64; learned W64x16. Joint BPR BP of all learned parameters.
models.interpretation: With unconstrained freeV, text model has same scoring function class as MF. Text branch supplies shared inductive bias/regularization/optimization, not a new expressive model class. Nonzero W is not by itself evidence of semantic benefit.
models.selection: For each condition choose grid settings by seed42 validation NDCG@10; retrain seeds43,44 at selected settings, six trials per condition,18total.
models.negative_sampling: Training-unobserved items; positives rating>=4; lower-rated observed training items excluded from negatives.
models.device: Laboratory A100 CUDA if available; matched conditions on same device/software; all numerical ranking evaluation uses canonical CPU scorer.

fixed_fusion.primary: Existing locked aligned degree-normalized rating SVD target blended with BP factors, alpha0.5,beta0.25. In text model act on effective V+XW; keep W unchanged and implement delta through V. No new per-model tuning of primary coefficients.
fixed_fusion.supplementary: Eight candidates alpha[0.25,0.5,0.75,1] x beta[0,0.25], select by validation with unchanged baseline eligible. Matches editor scored candidate count, not adaptive feedback or compute.
fixed_fusion.norm: Joint actual learned parameter norm including W for text model; frozen X excluded. Clip delta to0.495. Record effective factor changes, since learned-parameter norm is parameterization-dependent.

conditions.none: No-text BP checkpoint plus full training interactions and ID-row mapping. No text vectors or descriptions.
conditions.numeric_text: Text BP checkpoint plus full training interactions, exact frozen64D X and raw4096D numeric title+description vectors, ID mapping. No raw titles/descriptions.
conditions.full_text: Same text BP checkpoint and numerical inputs as numeric_text, additionally item_id,title,description for each movie.

editors.isolation: Fresh no-parent-context agents with explicit own-case allowlists. Shared workspace tools are not OS-level isolated; this limitation must be disclosed.
editors.prompt: Generic improvement of validation NDCG@10. Do not supply prior results, issue categories, algorithm examples, hypotheses or expected text advantage. Require concise observable findings before feedback, not private reasoning traces.
editors.feedback: Own candidate IDs and validation NDCG or generic invalid status only.
editors.allowed: Training statistics/forward predictions/residuals, direct algebra and one-shot analytic fitting, raw-description interpretation in full_text.
editors.forbidden: BP, gradients, iterative model fitting, automated candidate/parameter search, validation/test rows, external files/internet/other agents.
editors.patch: Generic add/multiply/replace/left/right-multiply, max6operations, max20MiB assets,maxabsolutevalue100,maxrelativelearnedparameterL2change0.5. All learned parameters editable, frozen features not editable.
editors.reproduction: Archive generation code and portable.py build(state,train,features); features None for none, dict projected64 and llama4096 otherwise. Reproduce all valid submitted candidates within1e-6 before freeze. Full-text semantic annotations can be compiled constants derived from allowed descriptions; no external calls.

selection_and_test: Every candidate starts from its assigned BP checkpoint. Validation selects best of eight plus unchanged baseline; immutable numerical snapshots and before-feedback observations. Hash all inputs, code, controls, candidates and choices before one final test reporting pass. No selection by test results.

evaluation.primary: Full catalogue NDCG@10 and Recall@10, positives rating>=4; exclude train during validation, train+valid during test.
evaluation.main: Text BP vs fixed text SVD+BP vs full_text Astra. Also fresh no-text three-way comparison and numeric_text Astra to separate feature integration from readable text access.
evaluation.aggregation: Keep per-seed and editor-replicate outcomes. Average editor replicates within each training seed before condition means/paired-user uncertainty. Three training seeds are not six independent models; conditional user intervals do not estimate editor/training population uncertainty.
evaluation.diagnostics: Training-count user/item groups, text branch contribution, parameter blocks changed, effectivefactor changes, selected fallback, fixed vs eight-grid controls, supplementary shuffled text BP. No fairness/coldstart claims solely from sparse groups.

costs: Record18BP trials,144candidate scores,36editorgenerationturns, measuredlocal/GPU times and software/device. No new Llama encoding cost; historical encoding cost separately. Native per-call tokens and dollar billing unknown unless actually exposed; aggregate goal-counter usage separate from invoices.
interpretation: Do not infer raw-description causality from a single response; paired input conditions use two fresh trajectories per seed but still limited stochastic sampling. Adding text does not establish new algorithmic innovation, LLM uniqueness, or superiority unless outcomes support them. Publish all failures and unchanged fallbacks.
